name: privacy-lens-vision-agent
description: SIH26171 - Privacy-preserving on-device vision agent for browser form-filling

scripts.setup: npm run fetch:vendor && npm run server:install
scripts.bench: node eval/bench/gen-corpus.mjs --seed 20260902 && node eval/bench/run.mjs && node eval/bench/redaction.mjs
scripts.bench:all: npm run bench && npm run bench:redaction && npm run bench:latency && npm run bench:screens && npm run bench:privacy && npm run bench:aggregate
scripts.bench:large: node eval/bench/gen-corpus.mjs --seed 20260902 --total 100000 --out eval/bench/corpus-100k.jsonl && node eval/bench/run.mjs --corpus eval/bench/corpus-100k.jsonl && node eval/bench/redaction.mjs --corpus eval/bench/corpus-100k.jsonl
